title: Polylogarithmic Regret via Certainty Equivalence in Degenerate LQR
abstract: arXiv:2611.21927v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Singular input penalties, as in minimum variance control, can reduce what must be identified to control an unknown linear system. In online linear quadratic control, certainty equivalence can achieve polylogarithmic regret when the optimal controller is identifiable from data collected under optimal feedback. With a positive definite input penalty, however, this condition is restrictive, since for an invertible state matrix it requires all unknown parameters to be identifiable under optimal feedback. We show that singular input penalties relax this requirement, expanding the class of problems in which certainty equivalence achieves polylogarithmic regret. Specifically, we prove that a certainty-equivalence algorithm with a short initial exploration phase achieves $O(\log^2 T)$ expected regret over $T$ interactions whenever controller identifiability holds. translated_title: 退化LQR中通过确定性等价实现多对数遗憾
translated_abstract: 奇异输入惩罚（如最小方差控制中所采用的）可以减少控制未知线性系统时所需辨识的内容。在在线线性二次控制中，当最优控制器能够从最优反馈下收集的数据中被辨识出来时，确定性等价方法可以实现多对数遗憾。然而，在正定输入惩罚的情况下，这一条件过于严苛，因为对于可逆状态矩阵，它要求所有未知参数在最优反馈下均可辨识。我们证明奇异输入惩罚放宽了这一要求，从而扩大了确定性等价能够实现多对数遗憾的问题类别。具体而言，我们证明了带有短期初始探索阶段的确定性等价算法，只要控制器可辨识性成立，在 T 次交互中即可达到 O(log²T) 的期望遗憾。我们同时给出了 Ω(√T) 的极小极大下界来补充这一保证。
tldr: 该论文证明在采用奇异输入惩罚的退化LQR问题中，带有短期初始探索的确定性等价算法在控制器可辨识条件下即可实现 O(log²T) 的多对数遗憾，相比正定输入惩罚大幅放宽了可辨识性要求，显著扩大了可获得多对数遗憾保证的问题范围。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that in degenerate LQR with singular input penalties, a certainty-equivalence algorithm with a short initial exploration phase achieves O(log²T) regret whenever controller identifiability holds, relaxing the stringent identifiability requirements of positive definite penalties and expanding the class of problems where polylogarithmic regret is attainable.
